headline: Executive order raises the minimum wage that companies holding federal government contracts must pay their workers.
what_it_does: This order, signed by President Biden in April 2021, increases the minimum hourly wage for workers employed by businesses that hold contracts with the federal government. No summary was provided, so the exact new wage amount, which contracts are covered, and other details are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They are set to receive a higher minimum hourly wage under covered federal contracts.

who_it_affects.group: Businesses that hold or seek federal government contracts
who_it_affects.how: They must pay covered workers at least the new, higher minimum wage.
They must include the higher wage requirement in the contracts they manage.
